# Product Intelligence Engine

Product Intelligence Engine is an independent, explainable product compatibility service.

## Public sections
- Homepage / guided mower finder: https://gunflo1011-debug.github.io/product-intelligence-engine/
- Product directory: https://gunflo1011-debug.github.io/product-intelligence-engine/products/
- Methodology and provenance: https://gunflo1011-debug.github.io/product-intelligence-engine/methodology.html
- Affiliate disclosure: https://gunflo1011-debug.github.io/product-intelligence-engine/affiliate-disclosure.html

## Data principles
- Technical product facts come from official manufacturer sources where possible.
- Unknown values remain unknown; they are not guessed.
- Compatibility uses explicit constraints such as lawn area, slope, boundary-wire requirements, multi-zone needs, and navigation risks.
- Affiliate commission never changes technical compatibility or ranking.
- Prices are timestamped observations, not guaranteed current prices.

## Current category
Wire-free robotic lawn mowers.
